limited.@expo/ui: no component newer than 57.0.11 (no NavigationStack, Toolbar, or NavigationSplitView)
limited.@sentry/react-native: JavaScript errors only; the native crash reporter is not in Expo Go
limited.@stripe/stripe-react-native: no Apple Pay and no Google Pay
limited.expo-auth-session: no OAuth sign-in in Expo Go; use Supabase email sign-in
limited.expo-notifications: local notifications only; no remote push
limited.expo-splash-screen: Expo Go shows the app icon, not the configured splash
limited.react-native-maps: Apple Maps only on iOS; Google Maps on Android

excluded.@expo/fingerprint: a Node build tool, not an app module
excluded.@react-native-community/viewpager: deprecated and not in Expo Go; use react-native-pager-view
excluded.eslint-config-expo: a lint config, not an app module
excluded.expo-analytics-amplitude: a removed legacy module, not in Expo Go
excluded.expo-app-auth: deprecated and removed, not in Expo Go
excluded.expo-app-loader-provider: a legacy internal package, not in Expo Go
excluded.expo-app-metrics: Expo Go leaves it out of its build
excluded.expo-apple-authentication: the iOS store Expo Go 57.0.9 lacks it
excluded.expo-background-fetch: deprecated and off in iOS Expo Go; use expo-background-task
excluded.expo-brownfield: a toolkit for existing native apps, not in Expo Go
excluded.expo-build-properties: a build-time config plugin with no app module
excluded.expo-dev-client: a build tool for development builds, not in Expo Go
excluded.expo-google-app-auth: deprecated and removed, not in Expo Go
excluded.expo-image-loader: an internal package of other Expo modules
excluded.expo-insights: Expo Go leaves it out of its build
excluded.expo-live-photo: the iOS store Expo Go 57.0.9 lacks it
excluded.expo-maps: needs a development build, not in Expo Go
excluded.expo-mcp: a Node tool for the editor, not an app module
excluded.expo-mesh-gradient: the store Expo Go 57.0.9 lacks it on iOS and Android
excluded.expo-module-template: a template to write native modules
excluded.expo-modules-core: an internal package; apps import from expo
excluded.expo-server: the server runtime of API routes, not an app module

excluded.expo-widgets: needs a development build, not in Expo Go
